title: Simple Spawn Set
description: A fast and lightweight spawn management plugin that lets server admins easily set the server spawn point with a simple command
body:
****Simple Spawn Set**** is a lightweight ****Minecraft plugin**** that allows server administrators to set the spawn location.

****Commands:****
• /setspawn — Set the server spawn (Admins only)                                                     
• /spawn — Teleport to spawn (All players)

****Perfect for SMP and survival servers.****
